Additionally, the student needs to strengthen their understanding of leaf structure and gas exchange mechanisms under environmental stress, ensuring that practical agricultural remedies provided in context-based scenarios are scientifically sound and realistic.

To improve, the candidate should focus on mastering detailed enzymatic pathways and pathophysiology mechanisms, while practicing the consistent use of precise biological vocabulary in descriptive essays.
